_note: Deterministic demonstration scenarios. Inputs are SYNTHETIC / SIMULATED overrides on the synthetic DEMO_MINE history (not MOIL records). Each scenario lists INPUTS only; the decision is COMPUTED by the forecast, recovery and contingency engines. expected_state is used only by the automated tests to confirm the engines still produce it.

DEMO_MINE.label: Current synthetic operating state (latest history, planned target)

DEMO_A.label: On track — healthy fleet, dry week, near-term view

DEMO_B.label: Operationally recoverable — equipment dip and blast delays, near-term view

DEMO_C.label: Strategic contingency — planned ramp-up the mine cannot sustain under stress

DEMO_D.label: Review required — operating state outside the model's experience

DEMO_E.label: Satellite fallback — live imagery query unavailable, cached grid used within the distance limit

exploration_query.description: Live coordinate query is forced to fail (simulated outage). A point inside the study area falls back to the cached ~1 km grid; a point far outside it returns PREDICTION_UNAVAILABLE instead of a misleading nearest-cell value.

DEMO_F.label: Decision flip — same mine, stressed conditions change the decision
